title: Solutions + Pro Services weekly sync notes — 2026-09-01
content:
Weekly sync: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services — 2026-09-01

Attendees: Ava Chen (notes/facilitator), Rohit Patel, Maya Gonzalez, Ethan Brooks, Leah Kim, Samir Das (SRE, joined for security items)

Agenda:
- Quick round of customer integration status updates
- Escalations / blockers
- Upcoming milestones / demos / cutover windows
- Action items and owners

Summary / high-level:
- Progress is steady on three integration tracks (Acme, FinFlow, Healthrix). EduSolve rollout is delayed pending license & KMS answers. RetailPro is in feasibility and scope refinement.
- Primary cross-team blockers this week: KMS admin permissions for customer-managed keys (blocked EduSolve), final network ACLs for Dedicated (Acme), and a regression in streaming chunking that may affect latency-sensitive demos (FinFlow).

Customer updates (detailed):

1) Acme Corp (Account team: Maya / Solutions lead: Rohit)
- Status: Pre-production environment provisioned on Redwood Dedicated. Basic smoke tests passed.
- Recent work: Model variant pinned (redwood/gptx-13b-v1-q4), autoscaler policy applied, initial load test (10k tokens/min sustained) completed with 95th pct latency ~220ms.
- Blockers: Network ACLs for partner IP range still not fully applied by infra (ticket JIRA-PS-430). Without ACLs, can’t start live traffic test.
- Risk: If ACLs not ready by 2026-09-07, customer demo may need to be postponed.
- Next milestone: Live traffic test + cost runbook review, target 2026-09-08.
- Action items: Rohit to follow up with infra (Samir) on ACL timeline — due 2026-09-02. Maya to prepare demo runbook — due 2026-09-04.

2) FinFlow (Payments / low-latency use case — Solutions: Ethan)
- Status: In-progress, internal UAT. Integrating streaming responses and function-calling for transaction enrichment.
- Recent work: Implemented streaming fallback when tokenization spikes occur; working PR submitted to runtime (see linked PR).
- Blockers: Observed a regression in streaming chunking (runtime PR introduced off-by-one in buffer flush) causing higher tail latency in 2/3 runs. Engineering triage in progress.
- Risk: Demo for FinFlow scheduled 2026-09-10; if regression not fixed, fallback to non-streaming (higher latency) will be used.
- Next milestone: Fix regression + run perf profile, target 2026-09-05.
- Action items: Ethan to own runtime triage and coordinate with serving-runtime team — update by 2026-09-03. Devs to add perf test in CI for streaming chunk edge cases — assigned to serving-runtime (PR author).

3) Healthrix (Healthcare customer — Pro Services lead: Leah)
- Status: Security review and PHI handling checklist in progress. Private deployment design sign-off expected this week.
- Recent work: Completed assimilation of audit log requirements; start of KMS integration design with customer.
- Blockers: Customer requires HSM-backed KMS; need architecture confirmation from security.
- Risk: Additional lead time for HSM procurement could push POC start by 2-3 weeks.
- Next milestone: Security sign-off on HSM approach, target 2026-09-06.
- Action items: Leah to coordinate with Security (Samir) for HSM options and share architecture note — due 2026-09-04. Samir to provide compliance checklist and recommended vendors — due 2026-09-03.

4) EduSolve (EdTech pilot — Solutions: Ava)
- Status: Stalled. Customer awaiting final licensing terms and confirmation on KMS key ownership flow.
- Recent work: Legal shared updated licensing draft; product matched usage quotas with customer.
- Blockers: KMS admin role required for customer-managed key import; internal IAM policy needs update.
- Risk: High — KMS and licensing must be resolved before any data ingress.
- Next milestone: Legal and IAM decision, target 2026-09-07.
- Action items: Ava to escalate licensing question to Legal (attached Confluence), and Product to propose an interim flow that preserves data ownership — due 2026-09-03.

5) RetailPro (Proof-of-concept scoping — Solutions: Rohit)
- Status: Discovery phase. Running feasibility on on-device quantized models vs Dedicated.
- Recent work: Cost modeling completed; initial recommendation favors Dedicated for <500 req/s but with aggressive batching.
- Blockers: Customer wants a demonstration of quantized quality vs baseline; we need a short eval harness.
- Action items: Rohit to create a short eval harness (2 prompts, 200 examples) and run A/B by 2026-09-08.

Cross-team items / platform notes:
- Release window: Scheduled minor runtime patch 2026-09-04 to address streaming regression; must land before FinFlow demo. QA already started.
- Observability: Console retention for token-level traces increased for FinFlow and Acme for the next 7 days to capture tail behavior — product ops approved.
- Billing: Usage-metering validation in Dedicated for Acme in progress; finance will be looped in when live traffic begins.
- Security: SRE (Samir) flagged a requirement for enhanced audit log retention for Healthrix (HIPAA). Need formal sign-off on retention window.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Who owns final sign-off for HSM vendor selection? Product or Security? (Action: Samir to propose decision owner.)
- EduSolve licensing has one clause (data residency in EU) that might require a Private-only deployment — confirm with customer.
- Can we short-circuit ACLs for Acme using temporary NAT? Pros/cons — Rohit to propose technical workaround if infra cannot deliver ACLs in time.

Decisions made this meeting:
- Proceed with runtime hotfix for streaming regression as priority A and schedule rollback plan if perf metrics degrade.
- Approve temporary extended trace retention for Acme/FinFlow for 7 days.

Action items (summary):
- Rohit: Follow up with infra (Samir) on Acme ACLs and propose NAT workaround if needed — due 2026-09-02.
- Maya: Draft demo runbook for Acme live traffic test — due 2026-09-04.
- Ethan: Own runtime triage for streaming regression; coordinate fix and CI perf test — update 2026-09-03.
- Leah: Coordinate HSM architecture note and vendor options with Security — due 2026-09-04.
- Ava: Escalate EduSolve licensing to Legal and propose interim data flow — due 2026-09-03.
- Samir (SRE): Provide compliance checklist for Healthrix and propose decision owner for HSM selection — due 2026-09-03.

Next meeting: Weekly sync on 2026-09-08, 10:00 AM PT. Will add a short pre-meeting spike (15m) for streaming regression status if the fix timeline slips.

Notes / rough brainstorm (informal):
- Consider a small “quickstart” template for Dedicated ACLs to reduce infra turnaround time — could be a 1-pager the Solutions team hands off.
- Add a checklist to the onboarding Confluence page for HSM vs KMS choices to avoid repeated security back-and-forths.

Attach: link to Confluence draft for EduSolve licensing, JIRA-PS-430 (Acme ACLs), JIRA-PS-421 (FinFlow streaming regression).

End of notes.
